front: Wembanyama (40 points with 9 blocks in 25 minutes), Davis (44 back from his ankle) and Flagg (43) broke Monday's slate open, while Golden State won by 51 and held Curry to 21 minutes. Barnes and Reaves were ruled out late, so Toronto and the Lakers sit out the morning grades. Your 95 teams had a median finish in the top 37%: 11 made the top 10%, none the top 1%, and they returned $303 on $455 in entries. The lesson is in the morning: you pushed Davis and Murray down while both were Questionable, against the rule that keeps a Questionable player in his tier, and both played big (61 and 51 fantasy points). That is most of why your morning board was right on only 24% of its disagreements with our projection (55% on the season). Nothing to decide today.

moves.2: Five of the six morning moves were one idea: Davis, Questionable at the morning lock, dropped behind Reaves, Lendeborg, Kessler and Booker. He played 34 minutes for 61 points, and Reaves was ruled out later.
moves.3: Three of the five morning moves pushed Murray, Questionable at the morning lock, behind Jerome, Boozer and Thompson; he played through it for 51 points.

card: The 1/2-turn fallers didn't pay last night (1 of 13 teams in the top 10%), but that's one night against a season where taking them is proven to help so far.
